title: 直接銅對銅接合
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入銅表面形貌、接觸形成與界面電阻。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore copper topography, contact formation and interface resistance, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 表面與界面設計
stages.description: 針對表面與界面設計完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for surface and interface design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 銅與介電界面區分｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對銅與介電界面區分，把「直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For separate cu and dielectric interfaces, turn "Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「銅與介電界面區分」的模型：直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for separate cu and dielectric interfaces: Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付銅與介電界面區分的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for separate cu and dielectric interfaces, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 銅與介電界面區分：機制
knowledge.titleEn: Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces: mechanism
knowledge.text: 直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。
knowledge.textEn: Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 必須排除的錯判：所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「直接銅對銅接合」的「銅與介電界面區分｜機制與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces | mechanism and design” in “Direct copper-to-copper bonding”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 在「銅與介電界面區分」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For separate cu and dielectric interfaces — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。
所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面
提高名義壓力必定線性降低接觸電阻
optionsEn: Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding.
Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface
Assuming pressure reduces contact resistance linearly without limit
quiz.explanation: 直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。 畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 因此不能採用「所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面」。
quiz.explanationEn: Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding. Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Therefore reject: Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface.

steps.title: 銅與介電界面區分｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對銅與介電界面區分，把「直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For separate cu and dielectric interfaces, turn "Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 將「所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Challenge the hypothesis "Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付銅與介電界面區分的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for separate cu and dielectric interfaces: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 表面氧化與等待時間｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Oxidation and queue time | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對表面氧化與等待時間，把「表面狀態會隨清潔後暴露環境改變，等待時間是整合變數而不是行政記錄。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For oxidation and queue time, turn "Surface state changes with exposure after preparation; queue time is an integration variable, not merely a log entry." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「表面氧化與等待時間」的模型：表面狀態會隨清潔後暴露環境改變，等待時間是整合變數而不是行政記錄。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「將批次、暴露與接合電阻关联，必要時用表面分析區分氧化和有機物。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for oxidation and queue time: Surface state changes with exposure after preparation; queue time is an integration variable, not merely a log entry. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Correlate lot, exposure and resistance, using surface analysis to distinguish oxides from organics. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 將批次、暴露與接合電阻关联，必要時用表面分析區分氧化和有機物。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Correlate lot, exposure and resistance, using surface analysis to distinguish oxides from organics. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：清潔完成後表面狀態會永久不變。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming a prepared surface remains unchanged indefinitely. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付表面氧化與等待時間的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for oxidation and queue time, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

quiz.questionEn: For oxidation and queue time — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 清潔完成後表面狀態會永久不變
一張無接縫截面足以代表整片界面

Correlate lot, exposure and resistance, using surface analysis to distinguish oxides from organics. Therefore reject: Assuming a prepared surface remains unchanged indefinitely.

steps.title: 粗糙度頻譜｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Roughness spectrum | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對粗糙度頻譜，把「相同 RMS 粗糙度可能來自不同空間波長；接觸面積還受起伏尺度與翹曲控制。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For roughness spectrum, turn "Equal RMS roughness can contain different spatial wavelengths; contact area also depends on waviness and warpage." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「粗糙度頻譜」的模型：相同 RMS 粗糙度可能來自不同空間波長；接觸面積還受起伏尺度與翹曲控制。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較掃描尺寸、濾波條件與高度分布，避免把不同量測帶寬直接合併。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for roughness spectrum: Equal RMS roughness can contain different spatial wavelengths; contact area also depends on waviness and warpage. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare scan size, filtering and height distributions rather than merging different measurement bandwidths. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較掃描尺寸、濾波條件與高度分布，避免把不同量測帶寬直接合併。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare scan size, filtering and height distributions rather than merging different measurement bandwidths. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：相同 RMS 值代表相同真實接觸面積。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating equal RMS roughness with equal real contact area. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付粗糙度頻譜的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for roughness spectrum, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.

steps.observationEn: Compare scan size, filtering and height distributions rather than merging different measurement bandwidths. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：相同 RMS 值代表相同真實接觸面積。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating equal RMS roughness with equal real contact area. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付粗糙度頻譜的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for roughness spectrum: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.
